253:t_1:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Well then, everyone gathered here...」

253:t_1:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The information $$グーラ$$ gave the $$ゲッター$$ team, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s knowledge, our review of galactic star charts...」

253:t_1:8.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Combining all of that has led to a startling conclusion about our current location.」

253:t_1:9.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Skip the preamble and get on with it.」

253:t_1:10.en:
$$木下$$
「We're so eager to know that we can hardly sit still.」

253:t_1:12.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Believe it or not... We've determined that we're near the center of the galaxy!」

253:t_1:14.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and $$ラー・カイラム$$, separated from us in subspace, are probably in a similar situation.」

253:t_1:15.en:
$$田中司令$$
「They're probably several light-years away from us, though.」

253:t_1:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「So the galactic center is about 27,000 light-years from Earth...」

253:t_1:19.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... I've fought at the galactic center before... in my own world, though.」

253:t_1:20.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm impressed, $$ノリコ$$. I'd love to hear that story at leisure.」

253:t_1:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「Big Bro $$ニコラ$$... Don't interrupt the discussion to hit on her.」

253:t_1:22.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm sorry, I'm sorry, $$勝平$$. ...Well then, $$ノリコ$$... We'll talk later.」

253:t_1:25.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're in a bad mood, Princess.」

253:t_1:27.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Um, everyone... Aren't you... a little more surprised?」

253:t_1:28.en:
$$朔哉$$
「You say that, but we could already tell this wasn't the solar system.」

253:t_1:29.en:
$$赤木$$
「When we're this far from Earth, it doesn't even feel real.」

253:t_1:30.en:
$$青山$$
「The question is whether we can get back to Earth.」

253:t_1:31.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We have an answer to that, too. We can.」

253:t_1:34.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Wait a moment! I did say we can get back, but even the lowest estimate puts the trip at about ten years!」

253:t_1:37.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The distance $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ can cover in a hyperspace jump isn't that great.」

253:t_1:38.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We'll jump, survey our surroundings, then jump again once its energy builds up... All we can do is repeat that.」

253:t_1:39.en:
$$渓$$
「We jumped that whole distance in an instant, and now we're here...」

253:t_1:40.en:
$$凱$$
「$$ゲッター線$$ have incredible power...」

253:t_1:41.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$'s jump certainly came from $$ゲッター線$$, but our situation is somewhat different.」

253:t_1:42.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We were caught in the $$時空震動$$ at $$第２新東京市$$. We believe its power threw us to the galactic center.」

253:t_1:43.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The influence of $$ゲッター線$$ probably made us warp out into this sector, though.」

253:t_1:45.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Who knows... As I am not $$ゲッター線$$, I couldn't say.」

253:t_1:46.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn... I thought the $$ゲッター$$'s power could take us home in an instant, but it can't.」

253:t_1:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「This is bad... In ten years, I won't be an elementary-school president anymore.」

253:t_1:48.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's a shame. I wanted to graduate from elementary school with $$マッキー$$ and everyone.」

253:t_1:49.en:
$$柿小路$$
「We'll have to live a long time, Managing Director.」

253:t_1:50.en:
$$厚井$$
「Indeed, Executive Director. Let's both look after our health.」

253:t_1:51.en:
$$ランド$$
「First, we need to secure food and water. If this is a long trip, we have to do something about that.」

253:t_1:52.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「I hear the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ has at least two months' worth of supplies stored.」

253:t_1:53.en:
$$メール$$
「Then we have to figure something out within two months.」

253:t_1:54.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Um, everyone... You don't seem terribly shocked by that, either...」

253:t_1:55.en:
$$ランド$$
「Who has time for that? We've decided we're getting home, no matter what.」

253:t_1:56.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We were prepared for this the moment we were thrown here. We can't sit around feeling down now.」

253:t_1:57.en:
$n
「All that's left is to think about how much we can shorten the trip.」

253:t_1:59.en:
$$葵$$
「That's a shame, $$田中$$. Did you want to see us despair?」

253:t_1:60.en:
$$シモン$$
「Sorry, but we left that feeling called despair behind somewhere.」

253:t_1:61.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, well... Your optimism far exceeded what $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ and I expected.」

253:t_1:62.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Of course, I'm a member of $c, too. If you were discouraged, I was planning to give your butts a good slap.」

253:t_1:63.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Thank goodness... If we'd despaired, $$田中$$ would have touched us.」

253:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's sexual harassment and an abuse of authority!」

253:t_1:65.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Haha... I was counting my chickens before they hatched.」

253:t_1:66.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$田中$$, you and the others figure out how to get home as soon as possible.」

253:t_1:67.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll deal with anyone who gets in the way.」

253:t_1:68.en:
$$隼人$$
「Judging by what we saw today, the $$インベーダー#robot$$s will show up again, too.」

253:t_1:69.en:
$n
「$$サイデリアル$$ will show up again, too.」

253:t_1:70.en:
$$赤木$$
「Speaking of them...! Why are they here?!」

253:t_1:71.en:
$$甲児$$
「According to $$レド$$, $$サイデリアル$$ is also fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$ at the galactic center.」

253:t_1:72.en:
$$甲児$$
「He said their main force is at the galactic center. It's unusual for them to be in a backwater like Earth.」

253:t_1:73.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then it's unusual for $$アウストラリス$$, $$サイデリアル$$'s ruler, to be on Earth, too.」

253:t_1:74.en:
$$ランド$$
「They're after Earth's $$次元力|lc$$. That means Earth is that valuable.」

253:t_1:75.en:
$n
「So they're gathering $$スフィア・リアクター$$s to use Earth's $$次元力|lc$$ against the $$人類銀河同盟$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s...」

253:t_1:76.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then doesn't $$サイデリアル$$ have technology that makes getting to Earth much easier?」

253:t_1:79.en:
$$恵子$$
「We might be able to get back to Earth sooner!」

253:t_1:80.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's great! Come on over, dear little $$サイデリアル$$!」
